# braidworks resume

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cli_docs.py from `braidworks --help`; do not edit by hand.
     Run `make cli-docs` after changing the command line. -->

Continue a saved run with its original query settings. For the task this serves, see the [how-to guides](../../how-to/).

```text
usage: braidworks resume RUN_ID --run-db PATH [options]

Continue a saved run with its original query settings.

positional arguments:
  run_id                the saved run to continue (see `braidworks runs`).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-db PATH         the saved-run store.
  --decision ENTITY_KEY=select:INDEX|accept|reject
                        explicit saved review decision; select INDEX is zero-based; repeatable.
  --format {human,json,jsonl,tsv,csv}
                        output format (default: human).
  --references          print source citations to stderr.

Advanced: sources, cache and archives:
  --only SOURCES        restrict to these source ids (comma/space separated).
  --strict              exit non-zero if any input is unresolved or needs review.
  --cache-db PATH       opt-in local SQLite lookup cache.
  --cache-positive-ttl SECONDS
                        lifetime of found/ambiguous cache entries (default: 3600); 0 disables
                        caching them.
  --cache-negative-ttl SECONDS
                        lifetime of no-match cache entries (default: 300); 0 disables caching
                        them.
  --cache-max-bytes BYTES
                        cache payload budget (default: 256 MiB); the SQLite file size may differ.
  --lease-seconds SECONDS
                        run owner lease, renewed while executing (default: 60).
  --archive PATH        save a self-contained JSON run archive (new file; no overwrite).

examples:
  braidworks resume p53 --run-db runs.sqlite
  braidworks resume p53 --run-db runs.sqlite --decision KEY=select:0
```
